title: Greedy Sine versus the Parity Barrier: Sylvester-Sparsity and Three Refuted Bridges
summary: Sylvester-sparsity for the greedy support (m_{i+1} >= m_i(m_i-1)+1), proved on paper and verified with zero violations, forces density ~3.9e-5 and empties the specified |A|>=20 test; the correct sparse bound replaces the false rh46 constant 2 (witness A={5}, x=5). The three bridges from the greedy word to lambda-parity (support, budgets, zeta machinery) are refuted with size-matched controls and an exact twist identity; the round's 'additive character in log n' phrasing is withdrawn after audit; the impossibility stays heuristic and two-point Chowla is open. There is deliberately no Lean layer: the round's Lean directory is empty, R4 open.
recipe_md:
Run from the folder. Both scripts write their log next to the script (the probe creates a `verify/` directory); run them in a copy if the folder must stay clean.

```sh
python3 greedy_parity_probe.py   # expect exit 0, "23 checks pass, 0 fail" (13.6 s here; the shipped first run took 26491.0 s with 21/1)
python3 independent_check.py     # expect exit 0, "RESULT: 31/31 checks pass" (154.4 s here; 38.8 s recorded)
```

Expected representative lines: `[PASS] S1.rigidity.no.violations | ... 53159 consecutive pairs ... (0 violations)`; `[PASS] S2.kill.positional.control | ... z = 0.4342 (p = 0.664)`; `[PASS] S4.no.euler.product | |D(2) - naive Euler product| = 2.014387 ...`; `[PASS] C1.2d twist invariance | ... 0 mismatches`; `[PASS] C4a quoted constant refuted | witness A={5}, x=5 ...`. There is no `check.sh`: the folder deliberately has no Lean development.
